'''Kalanadi''' ({{ipa|wkl|kɐlɐnaɖi|ipa}}) is a [[Southern Dravidian languages|Southern Dravidian language]] of [[India]]. It is most similar to [[Pathiya language|Pathiya]] with which it shares 88% lexical similarity.
